headline: Deadlocked reaches 6.07% matched code for NTSC-U v1.00
summary: Deadlocked’s NTSC-U v1.00 rises from 5.57% to 6.07% matched code, reaching 4,475 of 18,085 matched functions. Two independent batches add 157 and 167 matches across game, engine and network code (#50, #51). PAL has its own final total of 5,138 of 18,113 matched functions.
highlights: PAL batches of 210 and 50 functions merge in #52 and #53. Integration fixes add a missing header and remove duplicate PAL implementations.
A tool correction reproduces how the original assembler loads floating-point constants, unblocking C for 27 PAL functions (#49). A separate PAL-only Tempus Station function lands in #48.
The batches also retain non-matching C drafts for further work (#50, #51). Another 30-function PAL proposal opened but has not merged (#54).
